items.why: Barron's notes AMD fell over 1% despite TSMC's bumper September sales, as investors focused on higher oil prices and rising Treasury yields instead of the strong AI-chip signal.
Focus returned to European self-driving rules after the EU vote on Tesla's Full Self-Driving was pushed from October to December, while the broader tape sank on surging oil.
Higher bond yields weighed on the semiconductor sector, per Barron's, as Nvidia cooled after record highs earlier this week ahead of its Oct 20-22 GTC Berlin event.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Oil up 4.5% after a fresh tanker attack; S&P futures down about 0.3%, Nasdaq futures down about 0.6%.
summary: Stocks opened lower as oil jumped more than 4% after a fresh tanker attack, pulling futures down and weighing on big tech despite TSMC's strong September revenue.
